title: PS3 real-corpus evaluation item (one line of items.jsonl)
description: Built by `python -m ps3_llm.real_corpus build` from drafts.jsonl. Annotation status is NOT stored here: it is derived from reviews.jsonl (see review.schema below). ps3_llm.real_corpus.validate_item enforces this schema plus the provenance and leakage rules described in README.md.

id.description: Stable question id; rct- = test, rcd- = dev.

category.description: answerable/numerical: the evidence states the answer (numerical = the key fact is a number). unanswerable: related passages from the same paper, which never states the answer. context_swap: an answerable question paired with passages from a different paper. out_of_corpus: topic absent from all 13 papers.

answerable.description: Whether the answer is in the SUPPLIED evidence (not whether it is in the PDF).

required_facts.description: Answer criteria. Each inner list is one required fact, satisfied if ANY alternative occurs in the answer (case-insensitive, word-boundary, thousands separators ignored). Every fact must be stated in the support quotes and satisfied by reference_answer.

reject.description: Phrases that make an answer wrong.

acceptable_variations.description: Example acceptable phrasings, for reviewers (not used for scoring).

gold_citations.description: Evidence chunk ids that support the answer (support chunks plus any evidence chunk containing a support quote).

source_document.description: The paper the question is about (null for out_of_corpus).

swap_of.description: For context_swap: id of the answerable item whose question is reused.

absent_terms.description: Terms verified absent from the evidence (and, for out_of_corpus, from the whole corpus).

distractor_answers.description: Plausible wrong answers a hallucinating model may give (informational).

label_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the label fields; reviews are bound to it.
Hash of the label the reviewer saw; a review of an older label is ignored (stale).

reviewer.description: Full name of a human reviewer; names that look like a model or tool are refused.
